title: Make Sure You Are Not a Pain in the Neck (part 2)
main_content:
[This article is divided into 2 parts! In part 1 the expression a pain in the neck was explained.]

Annoying people can make us angry, so angry that we may want to wring their necks.

This is a common threat to say when we are angry at someone, as in this example: “She stole my idea for a book. I could just wring her scrawny, little neck!”

To stick your neck out means to take a chance or a risk. You can stick your neck out by investing a lot of money in a risky business deal.

To stick your neck out also means to put yourself at risk for someone else.

This phrase also means to give an opinion that other people may not like or that other people are scared to give.

For example, “She really stuck her neck out at the meeting for saying what she did.”

Now, if you are up to your neck (in something), you are either busy or in a very difficult situation.

And if you are up to your neck in debt, you owe a lot of money. When that happens, you may have the bank breathing down your neck. They keep calling and demanding their money back.

questions.question: When annoying people make us really angry, what do we want to do to them?
options: We want to ignore them completely.
We may want to threaten them verbally.
We may want to wring their necks.
We want to ask them to leave.
questions.answer: We may want to wring their necks.

questions.question: Can you list all the meanings that the expression ‘stick your neck out..’ has?
options: To support someone without hesitation and take responsibility.
To take a chance, give an unpopular opinion, or risk oneself for another.
To express an opinion only when it is popular.
To withdraw from the situation completely.
questions.answer: To take a chance, give an unpopular opinion, or risk oneself for another.

questions.question: What are you if your are “up to your neck in something”?
options: You are relaxed and not worried about anything.
You are in a very difficult situation or very busy.
You are enjoying a leisurely activity.
You are completely unaware of your surroundings.
questions.answer: You are in a very difficult situation or very busy.
